description: List a plugin's actions and triggers (filter=getAllActions, identifier=<pluginId>), or get one (filter=getActionDetails, identifier=<actionId>). Use it to find an actionId.

filter.description: Required. getAllActions (by plugin) or getActionDetails (one action by rowid). e.g. getAllActions

identifier.description: Required. Plugin id for getAllActions; action id for getActionDetails

name: list_actions_and_triggers
